summary: Hook the ceiling, swing, release at the right moment and carry the momentum - a speed-focused 2D swinging platformer in Godot 4; medal times measured on 13 of 14 levels by a scripted bot. Turkish UI.
key_features: Swing physics with no jump button: hook a ceiling anchor, swing, release at the right moment and keep the momentum
14 hand-built levels; medal times on 13 of them measured by a scripted bot rather than guessed
All sprites generated from code (tools/sprite_uret.gd), so the art is reproducible from the repository
Single-finger control scheme for touch, documented alongside the keyboard layout

Medal thresholds come from a bot that really plays each level, and CI re-runs it on every push: every level has to still finish and the published gold has to still be a time the bot can reach - which is how level 5's gold was found to be 3.5s faster than the bot's own median

social.headline: One key. One rope. All the momentum you can carry.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written and reviewed; no field is generated from a guess
